key_impacts: Approximately 8,500,000 customers lost power at peak during Sandy.
Two New Jersey refineries (Port Reading and Bayway/Phillips 66 in Linden) shut down, removing 26.3% of 1,170,200 bpd capacity.
Three health care facilities in Manhattan and Brooklyn evacuated all patients due to power outages.
Flooding in New York City exceeded 100-year floodplain boundaries by 53% citywide.
Gas stations in New Jersey could not operate due to power outages.
evidence_snippets: Sandy arrived the evening of October 29, coinciding with high tide and generating a massive surge in New York Harbor.
By Nov 6, 2012, refineries at Port Reading and Linden, NJ were shut; 26.3% of 1,170,200 bpd capacity lost.
Three health care facilities in Manhattan and Brooklyn evacuated all patients due to the outage.
missing_information: Event duration beyond 2012-10-29 not precisely specified.
Specific hospital names and detailed sub-area impact figures are not provided.
